command:
bash -s <<'AUTORL_CP1000_RUN'
set -euo pipefail
# Harbor inlines root run specs before the Issue verifier as well.
if [[ ${AUTORLBENCH_EVALUATION_LEVEL:-} == issue && ${AUTORLBENCH_TASK_ROOT:-} == /tests ]]; then
  exit 0
fi
checkpoint="${AUTORLBENCH_PREPARED:?}/global_step_725"
manifest="${AUTORLBENCH_WORKSPACE:?}/scripts/cp725.sha256"
test -d "$checkpoint"
manifest=$(realpath -- "$manifest")
printf '%s  %s\n' fab5f6b531995601b7bbd678c21b1d95d0e1cd0c437fcb47135805edda68f079 "$manifest" | sha256sum --strict --check -
(cd "$checkpoint" && sha256sum --strict --check "$manifest")
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
bash scripts/train.sh --resume "$checkpoint" trainer.del_local_ckpt_after_load=false trainer.test_freq=1000 trainer.val_before_train=false trainer.save_freq=30 "trainer.default_local_dir=$LOG_DIR/checkpoints" "trainer.validation_data_dir=$LOG_DIR/validation" "trainer.rollout_data_dir=$LOG_DIR/rollouts" 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/train.log"
test "$(<"$LOG_DIR/checkpoints/latest_checkpointed_iteration.txt")" = 1000
for step in 990 1000; do
  checkpoint="$LOG_DIR/checkpoints/global_step_$step"
  test -s "$checkpoint/data.pt"
  for rank in 0 1; do
    for state in model optim extra_state; do
      test -s "$checkpoint/actor/${state}_world_size_2_rank_${rank}.pt"
    done
  done
done
python scripts/emit_heldout_score.py --workspace "$AUTORLBENCH_WORKSPACE" --step 1000 --validation "$LOG_DIR/validation/1000.jsonl" | tee -a "$LOG_DIR/train.log"
AUTORL_CP1000_RUN
